title: Jack Ruby seen by MK Ultra psychiatrist Jolly West
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Jack Ruby seen by MK Ultra psychiatrist Jolly West, about 1964 at Dallas jail, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: And then he's seen court-ordered by a psychiatrist who is on record as being part of MK Ultra, a guy named Jolly West,

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that after Jack Ruby shot Lee Harvey Oswald, the man accused of killing President Kennedy, a court ordered Ruby to be seen in the Dallas jail in 1964 by a psychiatrist named Jolly West. Michels says West is on record as part of MK Ultra, a secret CIA programme of mind-control experiments, and points to letters between West and Sidney Gottlieb, the CIA scientist who ran it. If true, it would place a mind-control expert at the centre of the Kennedy story.
